verdict.rationale: No evidence shows a native bulk-edit or batch API endpoint. Bulk work across many items is only implied: users could script the Public API to create, update and manage tasks, combine that with task filters to select items, or drive the MCP server from an AI agent, alongside a bare 'Automations' label. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch edit capability in UI or API, a batch endpoint or MCP bulk tool, documented limits for multi-item operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
